title: Answers Often Arrive Sideways
core_idea: Inner answers rarely come while we stare at a question; they tend to surface later, while the hands are busy and the mind has loosened its grip.
text: Have you noticed that the clearest answers rarely come when you are trying hardest to find them? You sit with a question, turn it over again and again, and nothing moves. Then, hours later, you are rinsing a cup or walking to the shop, and there it is. Quiet. Obvious. As if it had been waiting for you to look away. Perhaps that is how inner knowing often works. It does not like to be cornered. So today, try asking your question once, honestly, and then set it down. Wash the dishes. Take the long way home. Let your hands stay busy and your mind go soft. The answer may arrive sideways.
description: A gentle reflection on how inner answers often surface when we stop chasing them and let the mind rest.
